title: Canonical tab-group create drops the supported collapsed setting
surface: Tools > Catalog > tab_groups; canonical delegated tool
preconditions: Receipt-bound development build with signed-in member/admin, two owned disposable tabs and tab-group capability.
For deterministic source reproduction invoke real canonical handler with owned Chrome API stubs and retain forwarded arguments; this is not native proof.
reproduction: Invoke tab_groups with action=create, owned tab_ids, and collapsed=true.
Inspect Chrome tabGroups.update call and resulting group state; compare with create_tab_group invoked with identical options.
Repeat with collapsed=false and title/color controls; then explicitly update collapsed via tab_groups action=update.
expected: The canonical merger preserves the existing leaf create collapsed option, consistent with its explicit no-capability-loss charter.
actual: Source inspection shows create forwards tab_ids/title/color but omits collapsed; update forwards it. The canonical inline comment and generated description mention collapse only for update, so accepted schema input alone is not evidence; the defect is the lost existing leaf capability. Native behavior and deterministic RED verification remain pending.
evidence: src/lib/tools/handlers/canonical-mergers.ts module charter and tab_groups create branch
reproducibility: Deterministic guarded real canonical delegation seam: both create collapsed=true and collapsed=false fail; 71 sibling contract cases pass.

verification.source: Guarded ext-d-0148-tab-groups-red2-20261007: 73 cases, exactly two omitted-collapsed failures; worker evidence report pending.
